column3: MetaX-UBTech robot chip venture Xilect raises CNY500 million to take on Nvidia Thor
column4: Xilect, a robot-chip venture set up by Chinese GPU designer MetaX and humanoid robot maker UBTech Robotics, has completed a CNY500 million (US$74.76 million) angel round to build a domestic computing platform for embodied AI, with Nvidia's Thor as its benchmark.
